title: Reefer Cargo Services: Special Service and Remote Monitoring Tariff
content:
Four of the six Reefer Cargo Services tiers include a special service of their own, and five of them keep the unit under the line's remote monitoring. This tariff card gives the special service each tier includes with its flat price, whether the unit is remotely monitored, the monitoring price per calendar day at sea, and the number of hours within which the line undertakes to act on a remote alarm.

## Special service per tier

| Tier | Special service included | Charged under | Special service fee (USD per service) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | none | none | 0.00 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | none | none | 0.00 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | cold treatment | cold treatment fee | 350.00 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | controlled atmosphere | controlled atmosphere surcharge | 780.00 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | GDP handling | GDP handling fee | 550.00 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | superfreezing | superfreezer surcharge | 950.00 |

## Remote monitoring per tier

| Tier | Remotely monitored by the line | Monitoring fee (USD per calendar day at sea) | Alarm response standard (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | yes | 12.00 | 4 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | yes | 12.00 | 2 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | yes | 15.00 | 2 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | yes | 25.00 | 1 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | yes | 15.00 | 2 |

The alarm response figure is the line's service standard for acting on an alarm raised through remote monitoring; it reads 0 on the one tier whose units are not remotely monitored.

## Reading the card

- Standard carries neither a special service nor remote monitoring, so both of its price columns stand at 0.00.
- Monitored is remotely watched but has no special service.
- The fastest alarm standard, one hour, belongs to Pharma GDP; Monitored has the slowest among the monitored tiers, four hours.
- Controlled Atmosphere and Superfreezer share a monitoring rate of 15.00 per day but differ in their special service prices.
